findings.text: follow-on: cost booking moved from one summed entry per batch to one _book_cost per successful call, so a batch whose calls all fail now writes no step key where the old code wrote a batch entry; the accumulated PipelineCost total is unchanged and the production batch path passes cost=None, so impact is nil but the brief's "behaviour must not change" is not strictly held.

item_verdicts.diff: Read the single commit dd5b301f0 in full; it adds CallStatus/CallOutcome/_settle_call/_await_call/_resume to judgment.py, the four-outcome test, and the landing fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when requires a shared unit, a four-outcome test that reddens on a changed classification, and recorded baseline/after suites; tests/discovery/test_judgment.py:333 adds that test and the manifest records both suites.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is one per-call unit shared by both decision entry points; imas_codex/discovery/base/judgment.py:88 defines _settle_call, and decide_one (:117) and decide_batch (:230) both rest on it.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records status complete, 193 passed/8 skipped after vs 192/8 baseline, names the gate command and result, and the negative-control log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared paths are imas_codex/discovery/base/judgment.py, tests/discovery/test_judgment.py and the fragment HTML; the diff touches exactly those three and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/discovery/test_judgment.py:365 pytest.raises(DecisionsValidationError) reddens when the shared unit is mutated to classify a malformed answer as transport, as negative_control.log records.
justifications.evidence: after_suite.log (dd5b301f0, 193 passed/8 skipped) and baseline_suite.log (192/8) are recorded with completed true, and negative_control.log shows the added test reddening with EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: CallStatus and CallOutcome at judgment.py:61/74 follow the file's docstring-heavy idiom and carry no plan or ticket label, with a plain Enum where sibling modules use StrEnum being the only minor deviation.
justifications.goal_fidelity: judgment.py:88 _settle_call is the single unit decide_one (:117) and decide_batch (:230) both call, and neither retains its own exception classification or cost booking.
justifications.reuse: no prior owner of call-fault classification exists in imas_codex/discovery/base/, and _settle_call extends the existing _book_cost (judgment.py:48) rather than duplicating it.
justifications.scope_discipline: the single commit dd5b301f0 changes only judgment.py, tests/discovery/test_judgment.py and the fragment HTML, all inside the declared write paths.
